pages.title: Dense Stone
pages.text: Between any two grains of it there is another: a stone with no gaps, and no smallest piece. Found in the Continuum (the Platonic Realm, Y 880 to 1040). The Analytic Continuator draws Transcendental Crystals out of it, and makes more from cobblestone and Epsilon Dust.
Made in $(item)Analytic Continuator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Real Analysis.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Transcendental Crystal.
